pipeline.name: ${var.name}
pipeline.definition: {"Comment": "Stage -> GX gate -> publish -> Athena gold -> serve", "StartAt": "Begin", "TimeoutSeconds": 3600, "States": {"Begin": {"Type": "Pass", "Parameters": {"run_id.$": "States.UUID()"}, "Next": "Stage"}, "Stage": {"Type": "Task", "Resource": "${var.batch_arn}", "Parameters": {"op": "stage", "run_id.$": "$.run_id"}, "ResultPath": "$.result", "TimeoutSeconds": 900, "Retry": [{"ErrorEquals": ["Lambda.ServiceException", "Lambda.AWSLambdaException", "Lambda.SdkClientException", "Lambda.TooManyRequestsException"], "IntervalSeconds": 2, "MaxAttempts": 2, "BackoffRate": 2}], "Catch": [{"ErrorEquals": ["States.ALL"], "ResultPath": "$.error", "Next": "ReleaseFailed"}], "Next": "QualityGate"}, "QualityGate": {"Type": "Task", "Resource": "${var.batch_arn}", "Parameters": {"op": "gate", "run_id.$": "$.run_id"}, "ResultPath": "$.result", "TimeoutSeconds": 900, "Retry": [{"ErrorEquals": ["Lambda.ServiceException", "Lambda.AWSLambdaException", "Lambda.SdkClientException", "Lambda.TooManyRequestsException"], "IntervalSeconds": 2, "MaxAttempts": 2, "BackoffRate": 2}], "Catch": [{"ErrorEquals": ["States.ALL"], "ResultPath": "$.error", "Next": "ReleaseFailed"}], "Next": "PublishSilver"}, "PublishSilver": {"Type": "Task", "Resource": "${var.batch_arn}", "Parameters": {"op": "publish", "run_id.$": "$.run_id"}, "ResultPath": "$.result", "TimeoutSeconds": 900, "Retry": [{"ErrorEquals": ["Lambda.ServiceException", "Lambda.AWSLambdaException", "Lambda.SdkClientException", "Lambda.TooManyRequestsException"], "IntervalSeconds": 2, "MaxAttempts": 2, "BackoffRate": 2}], "Catch": [{"ErrorEquals": ["States.ALL"], "ResultPath": "$.error", "Next": "ReleaseFailed"}], "Next": "Gold"}, "Gold": {"Type": "Task", "Resource": "${var.batch_arn}", "Parameters": {"op": "gold", "run_id.$": "$.run_id"}, "ResultPath": "$.result", "TimeoutSeconds": 900, "Retry": [{"ErrorEquals": ["Lambda.ServiceException", "Lambda.AWSLambdaException", "Lambda.SdkClientException", "Lambda.TooManyRequestsException"], "IntervalSeconds": 2, "MaxAttempts": 2, "BackoffRate": 2}], "Catch": [{"ErrorEquals": ["States.ALL"], "ResultPath": "$.error", "Next": "ReleaseFailed"}], "Next": "Release"}, "Release": {"Type": "Task", "Resource": "${var.batch_arn}", "Parameters": {"op": "release", "run_id.$": "$.run_id"}, "ResultPath": null, "Catch": [{"ErrorEquals": ["States.ALL"], "ResultPath": "$.release_error", "Next": "Alert"}], "Next": "Done"}, "ReleaseFailed": {"Type": "Task", "Resource": "${var.batch_arn}", "Parameters": {"op": "release", "run_id.$": "$.run_id"}, "ResultPath": null, "Catch": [{"ErrorEquals": ["States.ALL"], "ResultPath": "$.release_error", "Next": "Alert"}], "Next": "Alert"}, "Done": {"Type": "Succeed"}, "Alert": {"Type": "Task", "Resource": "arn:aws:states:::sns:publish", "Parameters": {"TopicArn": "${var.topic_arn}", "Message.$": "States.JsonToString($)"}, "Next": "Failed"}, "Failed": {"Type": "Fail", "Error": "PipelineFailed", "Cause": "Check execution history and quality report"}}}
